shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by|spec anchor|@spec|SPEC\" src test specs package.json vitest.config.* 2>/dev/null | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '220,270p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"spec:\" src scripts specs | head -100
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"Validates specs/\" src scripts | head -80
rg -n \"#([0-9]+)\" src/**/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts | head -80
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
ls scripts | rg 'reanchor|repoint'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/turnUsage.test.ts
git commit -m "Accumulate usage across tool rounds"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [[ "$(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD')\" -gt 0 ]]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
